headline: What is Mistral AI? Everything to know about the OpenAI competitor
snapshot: Mistral AI, which offers some open source AI models, has raised significant funding since its creation in 2023, with the ambition to "put frontier AI in the hands of everyone." The competitive question is whether this changes the model race, enterprise integrations or customer lock-in as major AI providers battle for durable platform advantage.
